reference.sourceHashMethod: SHA-256 over the exact bytes of files in the frozen GJC reference checkout. Third-party GitHub source/license hashes are Git blob SHA-1 values obtained from the pinned commit Contents API.
reference.counterConvention: Callbacks named in expected.counts are installed as counters unless a precondition explicitly states otherwise. App callbacks whose downstream effects are outside a fixture are instrumented no-op callbacks; stateful effects are modeled only where their source implementation is cited.

knownReferenceAmbiguities.detail: ParsedKittyResult.modifier is documented as excluding lock bits, but parse_kitty_sequence returns p.modifier directly and parse_csi_u stores mod_value - 1 without clearing LOCK_MASK. Key matching/formatting separately mask LOCK_MASK (64|128), while CustomEditor consumes bit 64 for its Caps Lock callback. The fixtures preserve both raw parsed bits and the masked match result; do not silently normalize the parse result to match its comment.

The pinned body uses the strict comparison now - lastSigintTime < 500. The cited upstream test demonstrates first-clear/second-shutdown but does not set an exact elapsed time; 499ms and 500ms outcomes below are derived from the literal comparison, not claimed as upstream test assertions.
